text:
Predicates:
Monday(x) ::: x is a Monday.
Time8pm(x) ::: x is 8 pm.
RoseGivenOutOnTV(x) ::: roses are given out on TV at time x.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealLives(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: Breaking Bad show.

Premises:
∃x (Monday(x) ∧ Time8pm(x) ∧ RoseGivenOutOnTV(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (RoseGivenOutOnTV(x) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortraysRealLives(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealLives(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.

Conclusion:
RoseGivenOutOnTV(BreakingBad) ∧ Monday(BreakingBad) ∧ Time8pm(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is a TV show in which roses are given out on Monday at 8 pm.
